text: 1. Applicant should be aged between 18 and 30 (born after September 1, 1992);2. Applicant should be non-Chinese citizens with a valid regular foreign passport;*Residents of Mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, and Taiwan who have emigrated to a foreign country and who are now applying to study in China as international students must have held a valid foreign passport for at least 4 years, and must have actually resided in a foreign country for at least 2 years in the past 4 years (as of April 30, 2022). (9 months of residence in a foreign country may count as a full year. The dates of the entry and exit stamps in the passport will be followed in the determination of the actual length of foreign residence).3. Applicant should hold a high school diploma with a satisfactory academic record;4. Language requirement: an applicant who applies for Chinese taught programs should have HSK 4 certificate or above, applicants who apply for English taught programs should have a TOEFL score above 80 (TOEFL MyBest scores are accepted, DI CODE: C824 ) or IELTS score above 5.5;5. Applicant should have no criminal record and no drug addiction history;6. Applicants should be in good health and have no serious infectious diseases.
